admission.justification: The launch must supply identity, the selector must fail closed and registration/dispatch must keep the narrow surface; the host-launch and bound-server regressions exercise these distinct locations.

applicability: Normal AR task-server startup for a process launched as an explainer, and calls to that bound server.
conditions: Launch supplies both the workspace marker and the capability binding.
The binding validates repository/task/leaf workspace shape, required values and a positive integer generation before registration.
Registration supplies the same explainer implementations on the already-created server instance.
Every tool call checks the launch binding against the current seat before its handler runs.
Central read-only annotations are applied after either roster registers; they describe capability and do not grant permission or prove process-wide purity.
exclusions: An ordinary process with neither marker nor binding retains the ordinary roster.
This statement does not claim operating-system confinement from tool discovery alone.
No ordinary roster fallback on a malformed or marker-backed missing binding.
statement: The normal AR task server selects the explainer’s 22-tool surface only from its valid launch-owned binding, enforces that surface at dispatch, and revalidates the exact launched seat on every tool call. An invalid, lost marker-backed or replaced seat binding refuses by name instead of exposing the ordinary roster; a process with neither explainer marker nor binding retains the ordinary roster. Both surfaces receive the central read-only marks, and an unclassified tool refuses.
